positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Amazon Game Studios, New World - Control Plane

I worked on the Control Plane team for New World, an MMORPG developed by Amazon Game Studios. The Control Plane team owned server management infrastructure, services, and internal tooling for managing/deploying software to game servers. I primarily worked on redesigning the server management backend from a legacy internal software stack to a new serverless native AWS solution (API Gateway, Lambda, Step Functions) that could scale for New World's full release. I also helped implement a server instancing solution to provide game servers with additional EC2 capacity for dungeons and other in game instanced content.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
Supply Chain Optimization Technology (SCOT) - Forecasting

I was an SDE I/II for the Demand Forecasting team within Amazon's SCOT org. While on the team I helped engineer and maintain various machine learning models used within Forecasting to predict demand for low demand items sold on Amazon.com. These models ranged in complexity from basic statistical models to complex neural networks. Additionally, I worked on various services ranging from on-demand promotion prediction to managing our organization's forecasting orchestration platform.

Some high level highlights:
• Experience with the Apache Spark framework using the Scala programming language.
• Experience building Java based backend services.
• Implemented solutions using AWS resources including but not limited to AWS S3, SQS, SNS, EMR, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, Lambda, and API Gateway. 
• Experience using Cloud Formation and CDK for AWS resource synthesis.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: I interned on the checkout page of Amazon's retail website. During my internship I designed and implemented a feedback widget that could be inserted into the checkout page to gather customer feedback at the end of the checkout process.

projects.title: Tap Dungeon
projects.description:
Game developed in Unity 3D and released on both Android and PC. Written in C#. 

A quick summary from the store page: The gameplay is simple, tap enemies to defeat them! For each enemy you defeat you earn gold which can be used to upgrade your attack, health, or block power. There are twenty floors for you to fight your way through, do you have what it takes?

Link to the PC version: https://jeffan.itch.io/tap-dungeon

projects.title: Dark Halls
projects.description: 3D horror game developed in Unity3D. Written in variant of Javascript known as Unityscript. Done mostly from scratch excluding textures and a few sound effects. Goal is to get to the of edge of the maze and find a lit up platform to escape to the next level.
